title: A Story Someone Else Wrote
subtitle: Value vs. Prestige
description: A blind tasting, and an argument that your own palate knows more than the price tag does. Every pour is scored with no labels, no prices and no bottles in the room. Then the samples are revealed one by one, the room's averages go on the board, and the prices go back on. Built around roles rather than a fixed lineup: a hyped bottle, a sleeper, a workhorse, a ringer and a barrel-proof closer, with two bottles from the same distillery at very different prices.
tags: blind tasting, bourbon, rye, value, price, bottled in bond, barrel proof, buffalo trace

pours.name: Buffalo Trace
pours.style: Kentucky straight bourbon, Mash Bill #1, no age statement
pours.notes: Sample A, the workhorse. Half of the same-distillery pair with sample B.

pours.name: Blanton's Original Single Barrel
pours.style: Single-barrel bourbon, Mash Bill #2, from Warehouse H
pours.notes: Sample B, the hyped one. Same distillery as sample A, at around three times the price.

pours.name: Evan Williams Bottled-in-Bond
pours.style: Kentucky straight bourbon, bottled in bond
pours.notes: Sample C, the sleeper. The cheapest bottle on the table, and the only one carrying a federal guarantee of how it was made.

pours.name: Four Roses Small Batch Select
pours.style: Kentucky straight bourbon, six of the distillery's ten recipes, non-chill-filtered
pours.notes: Sample D, a deliberately constructed blend: a bottle where the money buys something you can taste.

pours.name: Barrell Seagrass
pours.origin: Barrell Craft Spirits, Louisville, Kentucky (sourced American and Canadian rye)
pours.style: Rye whiskey finished in Martinique rum, Madeira and apricot brandy casks, cask strength
pours.notes: Sample E, the ringer: not a bourbon at all.

pours.name: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof
pours.style: Kentucky straight bourbon, barrel proof, batch-dated
pours.strength: Varies by batch (batch A125: 59.1% ABV, 118.2 proof)
pours.notes: Sample F, the closer. Poured last because its heat lingers longest; add a few drops of water and taste again.
